Name: DahniMae's Fae Animals
Author: littlemissgogo
Description: This is an updated version of "Fae Animals" by DahniMae on the Stardew Valley forums. It includes the (functional) cows, sheep, chickens, and dinosaur. The duck and shared baby chicken sprite aren't updated, but they are included. I may try to update those myself later. There is an additional chicken sprite added, not originally done by DahniMae.
